title: Understanding Model Bias
text: Model bias refers to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. High bias can occur if the model is too simple and cannot capture the underlying patterns in the data.

title: Using Additional Predictors
text: Adding more predictor variables can help the model capture more information about the data, potentially reducing bias. Consider how the additional variable might relate to the target variable.
